title: Unipotent tensor categories and pronilpotent Lie quasibialgebras
summary: We construct a bijection between tensor equivalence classes of unipotent tensor categories over $\C$ and continuous Lie quasibialgebras with linearly compact pronilpotent underlying Lie algebra, modulo continuous isomorphisms and classical twists. The bijection is defined using a fixed universal quantization functor and solves the problem raised in Remark~4.6 of arXiv:0708.1487 by Etingof and Gelaki.
